page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A4.Flex.4-64 is an ARM-based compute instance built on the Ampere AmpereOne-M processor architecture. The instance is configured with 8 dedicated physical cores running at 3.6 GHz, presenting 8 single-threaded vCPUs. Coupled with 64.0 GB of system memory, the platform provides an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio with 8.0 GB of RAM allocated per physical core. The architecture does not implement simultaneous multithreading, providing deterministic compute cycles per allocated core.

The instance does not include integrated local NVMe or SSD storage and features no hardware GPU accelerators, requiring reliance on external block and object storage services for persistent data volumes. Network connectivity includes a single complimentary public IPv4 address. Hardware virtualization flags standard on x86 platforms, such as AVX vector extensions or hardware AES instructions present in other families, are omitted or specific to the ARM instruction set architecture.

Because the 1:8 core-to-memory configuration delivers high memory density relative to core count, the shape operates efficiently for memory-centric deployments on ARM infrastructure. The single-threaded core execution eliminates noisy-neighbor core contention, making the instance suitable for in-memory caching layers, medium-scale relational databases, microservices fleets, and ARM64-native development pipelines.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A4.Flex.4-64 is an ARM-based virtual machine configured with 8 dedicated physical cores from the Ampere AmpereOne-M processor family operating at 3.6 GHz. Operating without multithreading, the instance provides 8 single-threaded vCPUs paired with 64.0 GB of memory, yielding an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance does not feature local storage volumes or GPU acceleration, requiring external network block storage for persistence. Network connectivity includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. The dedicated core model provides consistent single-threaded throughput without thread contention. This profile offers resource efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that benefit from ARM64 architecture, including in-memory databases, memory-bound caching servers, enterprise application backends, and containerized microservice deployments.
